stem: Two tissue samples from the same crop differ substantially, but they were taken from different leaf ages and canopy positions. What should be concluded first?
choices: Sampling inconsistency may explain part of the difference, so tissue comparisons need standardized plant part, developmental stage and sampling method
The crop changed genetics between samples
The higher value is automatically correct
Canopy position cannot affect tissue interpretation
rationale: Tissue analysis depends on sampling protocol. Differences in tissue age and position can confound interpretation if sampling is not standardized.
